name: hov-router
description: HoV Router - a load balancer proxy for Claude Code across multiple account providers

scripts.build: case "$HOV_ROUTER_BUILD_SUFFIX" in ""|*[!a-zA-Z0-9._-]*) if [ -n "$HOV_ROUTER_BUILD_SUFFIX" ]; then echo 'HOV_ROUTER_BUILD_SUFFIX must only contain alphanumeric characters, dots, underscores, and hyphens' >&2; exit 1; fi ;; esac && mkdir -p dist && bun -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('../../packages/database/src/inline-vacuum-worker.ts')) { fs.writeFileSync('../../packages/database/src/inline-vacuum-worker.ts', 'export const EMBEDDED_VACUUM_WORKER_CODE = \"\";'); }" && bun -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('../../packages/database/src/inline-incremental-vacuum-worker.ts')) { fs.writeFileSync('../../packages/database/src/inline-incremental-vacuum-worker.ts', 'export const EMBEDDED_INCREMENTAL_VACUUM_WORKER_CODE = \"\";'); }" && bun -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('../../packages/database/src/inline-integrity-check-worker.ts')) { fs.writeFileSync('../../packages/database/src/inline-integrity-check-worker.ts', 'export const EMBEDDED_INTEGRITY_CHECK_WORKER_CODE = \"\";'); }" && bun -e "const fs=require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('../../packages/database/src/inline-reader-worker.ts')) { fs.writeFileSync('../../packages/database/src/inline-reader-worker.ts', 'export const EMBEDDED_READER_WORKER_CODE = \"\";'); }" && bun build ../../packages/database/src/vacuum-worker.ts --outfile dist/vacuum-worker.js --target=bun --minify && bun -e "const fs=require('fs'); const code=fs.readFileSync('dist/vacuum-worker.js','utf8'); const encoded=Buffer.from(code).toString('base64'); fs.writeFileSync('../../packages/database/src/inline-vacuum-worker.ts', 'export const EMBEDDED_VACUUM_WORKER_CODE = \"' + encoded + '\";');" && bun build ../../packages/database/src/incremental-vacuum-worker.ts --outfile dist/incremental-vacuum-worker.js --target=bun --minify && bun -e "const fs=require('fs'); const code=fs.readFileSync('dist/incremental-vacuum-worker.js','utf8'); const encoded=Buffer.from(code).toString('base64'); fs.writeFileSync('../../packages/database/src/inline-incremental-vacuum-worker.ts', 'export const EMBEDDED_INCREMENTAL_VACUUM_WORKER_CODE = \"' + encoded + '\";');" && bun build ../../packages/database/src/integrity-check-worker.ts --outfile dist/integrity-check-worker.js --target=bun --minify && bun -e "const fs=require('fs'); const code=fs.readFileSync('dist/integrity-check-worker.js','utf8'); const encoded=Buffer.from(code).toString('base64'); fs.writeFileSync('../../packages/database/src/inline-integrity-check-worker.ts', 'export const EMBEDDED_INTEGRITY_CHECK_WORKER_CODE = \"' + encoded + '\";');" && bun build ../../packages/database/src/reader-worker.ts --outfile dist/reader-worker.js --target=bun --minify && bun -e "const fs=require('fs'); const code=fs.readFileSync('dist/reader-worker.js','utf8'); const encoded=Buffer.from(code).toString('base64'); fs.writeFileSync('../../packages/database/src/inline-reader-worker.ts', 'export const EMBEDDED_READER_WORKER_CODE = \"' + encoded + '\";');" && rm -f dist/hov-router && bun build src/compiled.ts --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --outfile dist/hov-router --target=bun --minify --define __HOV_ROUTER_VERSION__='\"'$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")$([ -n "$HOV_ROUTER_BUILD_SUFFIX" ] && printf "+%s" "$HOV_ROUTER_BUILD_SUFFIX")'\"' --define __HOV_ROUTER_GIT_SHA__='\"'$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)'\"' $(bun run --silent build-provenance.ts) && rm -f dist/vacuum-worker.js dist/incremental-vacuum-worker.js dist/integrity-check-worker.js dist/reader-worker.js
